# 💰 RupeeEconomyCompanies

RupeeEconomyCompanies is a powerful economy and business management plugin for Minecraft servers running Paper or Spigot (1.21+). It introduces a complete ₹ Rupee-based financial system where players can build companies, manage employees, run businesses, trade items, take bank loans, earn salaries, pay taxes, and participate in a server government.

Perfect for Economy SMP, Roleplay, and large multiplayer servers.

---

# 🌟 Features

## 💰 Economy System
• Full ₹ Rupee economy  
• Secure player transactions  
• Balance leaderboard  
• Anti-negative balance protection  
• Transaction ID logging  

## 🏦 Banking System
• Deposit and withdraw money  
• Transfer money between players  
• Loan system with repayment  
• Interest generation  
• Secure bank transaction logs  

## 🏢 Company System
• Player-owned companies  
• Company headquarters  
• Company bank accounts  
• Member management  
• Company reputation and leaderboard  

## 👔 Company Roles
Default roles (configurable):

CEO  
COO  
CFO  
Manager  
Employee  
Investor  
Supplier  
Marketing Manager  
Security  

Each role has configurable permissions inside roles.yml.
